raw.product_description: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" designed for AI-first companies. It comprises three layers: Observe (Layer 1) using lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns; an Intelligence Layer (Layer 2) that acts as a "Brain" to detect employee intent, business value, and workflow "drift"; and an Execution Layer (Layer 3), an "Agent Factory" that automatically generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for high-ROI opportunities. The system leverages existing foundation models and focuses on the "Work Graph" to optimize AI deployment.
raw.thesis: Narma is addressing the critical challenge faced by "AI-first" companies: effectively deploying and scaling AI automation. The core innovation lies in its "Enterprise Agentic Brain" which observes work patterns, detects employee intent and business value of tasks, and identifies "drift" from intended workflows. This intelligence then feeds into an "Agent Factory" that automates the generation, deployment, and monitoring of AI agents for high-ROI opportunities, ensuring continuous AI optimization. This venture is not merely describing a category; it proposes a new, integrated system to bridge the gap between AI aspiration and tangible, scalable AI automation. It is for AI-first companies (specific target user) who struggle with a lack of telemetry, unreliable ROI measurements, and workflow drift. The problem is severe because it directly impacts the ability of these companies to realize the promised efficiencies and cost savings of AI, leading to wasted resources and stagnation. The founder's goal appears to be a growth startup, aiming for significant adoption within the enterprise AI market. Given the description, the venture is at the concept/idea stage, as it outlines a system design but doesn't provide evidence of a built product or user traction.

core_insight.if_wrong: If Narma cannot accurately detect intent and business value from work patterns, or if its Agent Factory cannot effectively generate and deploy high-ROI agents, then companies will not achieve scalable AI automation, and AI investments will continue to yield unreliable returns.
core_insight.source_excerpt: a single system that observes how work happens, decides what AI should do next, and auto-builds agents continuously to ensure a 'Continuous AI lift.'
core_insight.why_different: Narma focuses on a holistic, integrated system that observes, understands, and then automates AI agent deployment based on real-time work patterns and business value, rather than just offering individual AI tools or consulting.
